annotations.title: Switch automatic replies for an account

description: Separately change one connected account’s automatic-reply switch: pass its platform, accountId, enabled, the exact expectedUpdatedAt from soclo_inbox_settings (null only for an absent switch) and a stable UUID clientRequestId. Preview first; pass confirm: true only after owner approval. Needs manage:inbox. After an uncertain save, read soclo_inbox_settings and reconcile before writing again.

accountId.description: The connected account id, from soclo_accounts_list or a prior inbox call.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact text or change. Omit or pass false to get a preview instead: nothing is sent, nothing is saved.

name: soclo_inbox_account_settings_save
title: Switch automatic replies for an account
